title: Arcsine kernels, inverse-binomial harmonic sums, and classical hypergeometric transformations
summary: We study inverse-central-binomial series with finite reciprocal-square factors and harmonic weights involving $H_n$, $H_{2n}$, and $1/n$. An arcsine integral gives explicit odd-zeta evaluations and a classification of coefficientwise cancellation within a polynomial ansatz. The scalar examples include an evaluation of weight seven and a direct proof of Sun's Conjecture 3.10. An entire generating relation organizes a second family with finite rational coefficient formulas. We then derive that relation, a supplementary generating family, and the complete two-order construction from Bailey's…
